title: Is Unlearning Reversible by Quantization Alone? A Tiny Audit

original_idea.body: Whether post-hoc int8/int4 quantization revives unlearned knowledge.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: if standard quantization silently undoes unlearning, every quantized 'safe' model is at risk.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: forget-set recovery after quantization vs full precision.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Neglected gold: deployment-realistic audit external researchers can do, public models.

low_compute.reasoning: Unlearning fine-tune + cheap quantization + inference eval.

novelty.reasoning: Quantization-attacks mentioned; focused isolation of quantization-only reversal may be open.
